references.text: Instructions for making tunics for Aaron's sons as part of the priestly garments
Description of how Aaron's sons are to be brought forward and clothed in tunics at their consecration
The tunics were made for Aaron and his sons just as the Lord had commanded
Moses brought Aaron's sons forward and clothed them in tunics during the consecration ceremony
The priestly garments are transferred from Aaron to his son Eleazar, demonstrating the hereditary nature of the priesthood
Describes the same ritual action (bringing forward and clothing) at the consecration of the priests.
Describes the preceding ritual action (washing and bringing forward) that is required before being clothed.
Being clothed is part of the larger process of anointing and ordination to the priesthood.
